title: Home Inspection Form
subtitle: Home Condition Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Home Inspection Form covers visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern. The home inspection coordinator records Home Condition Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Home Inspection Form keeps Home Condition Inspection exceptions visible until the home inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Home Inspection Form at residence exterior, interior, accessible attic, visible foundation, and installed systems. Document visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern identity before Home Condition Inspection begins. Compare visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern findings with stated Home Condition Inspection criteria; route unresolved Home Condition Inspection issues to qualified home-condition reviewer. For Home Inspection Form, confirm requirements for Home Condition Inspection. Ask qualified home-condition reviewer to review Home Condition Inspection conditions beyond the home inspection coordinator's role.
